name: @activepieces/piece-metabase
description: The simplest way to ask questions and learn from data

auth.description: Metabase authentication requires a baseUrl and a password.

apiKey.description: Generate one on your Metabase instance (settings -> authentication -> API keys)

embeddingKey.description: Needed if you want to generate a graph of a question (settings -> embedding -> static embedding).

getQuestion.name: getQuestion
getQuestion.description: Fetch the results of a Metabase question

aiMetadata.description: Runs a saved Metabase question (card) by its ID and returns the query result rows. Use to pull live data from an existing report rather than writing raw SQL. Optionally pass a parameters object (keyed by parameter slug) to filter the query; slugs not defined on the card are ignored. Read-only and idempotent — re-running with the same inputs re-executes the query without side effects.

getQuestionPngPreview.name: getQuestionPngPreview
getQuestionPngPreview.description: Get PNG preview rendering (low resolution) of a Metabase card/question.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches a low-resolution PNG preview image of a saved Metabase question (card) by its ID and saves it as a file. Use when an agent needs a quick visual snapshot of a report rather than the underlying data rows. Read-only and idempotent.

getDashboardQuestions.name: getDashboardQuestions
getDashboardQuestions.description: Execute all questions across all tabs in a Metabase dashboard and return their consolidated results in a single response

parameters.description: Dashboard parameters to apply to all questions

aiMetadata.description: Runs every question (card) on a Metabase dashboard, identified by dashboard ID, and returns all of their results plus the dashboard's available parameters in one consolidated response. Use to retrieve data from an entire dashboard at once rather than fetching cards individually. Optionally pass a parameters object (keyed by parameter slug) applied across all cards. Read-only and idempotent.

embedQuestion.name: embedQuestion
embedQuestion.description: Enable embedding for a Metabase question and configure parameters

enableEmbedding.description: Whether to enable embedding for this question

parameterSettings.description: Configure how each parameter should be handled in the embed

aiMetadata.description: Updates a Metabase question (card) by its ID to toggle static embedding on or off and set how each parameter is exposed in the embed (disabled, editable, or locked). Use when configuring a question for external embedding. This mutates the card's settings, but is idempotent — re-running with the same inputs leaves the card in the same configured state.

getGraphQuestion.name: getGraphQuestion
getGraphQuestion.displayName: Get the graph of the question
getGraphQuestion.description: Get the graph of a Metabase question and save it as a png

graphName.displayName: The name of the graph (without the extension)

waitTime.description: How long to wait for the graph to render completely in seconds

aiMetadata.description: Renders the chart/graph of a Metabase question (by ID) via a signed embed URL in a headless browser and saves a high-resolution PNG screenshot. Use when an agent needs the rendered visualization of a report rather than its data rows. Requires the connection's embedding key to be set and the question to be published for embedding; the question must already exist. Read-only and idempotent — it does not modify Metabase.

custom_api_call.name: custom_api_call
custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
